title: SOCIAL WILDCARD ignites 2025 with groovy rock soundtrack “YOU KNOW ME”
htmlContent:
Social Wildcard is kicking off the year with an exciting new single, "You Know Me," a song that combines the strong, lively sound of bands like Queens of the Stone Age with the cool vibe of Arctic Monkeys, showcasing Social Wildcard's talent.

"You Know Me" grabs your attention with its energetic beat, supported by powerful drums and guitars that exude confidence. The song balances a sense of wildness with a chill attitude. The vocals are full of self assurance, with lyrics that echo the familiarity between friends, reminding us that some bonds remain strong no matter how much time goes by.

https://open.spotify.com/track/0icJptOoJOWT95gt5SYkD4

The clear production allows each instrument to shine while keeping a steady, driving rhythm. There's a natural connection among the band members, reflecting their understanding of their music and message. Social Wildcard is making a strong impression, and this is just the start of what promises to be an eventful year.
